instruction.text: What do you think this stone hoop was used for during the times of the ancient Maya?

feedback.end: This stone hoop is part of a larger ball court, where the Maya played a game called pitz.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Pitz has sacred origins. In Maya mythology, the hero twins are invited by the gods of death to play a game in the underworld. This has earned pitz the name “Game of Death”.

hint.text: The hero twins were half god and half human. Their father was Hun Hunahpu, the god of maize.
hint.label: Hero twins

atoms.text: Historians have deciphered the rules of pitz by studying ball courts, clay figurines and paintings of the game on vases and murals.

The game is played with a solid rubber ball and protective leather pads. There are two teams, and the aim is to knock the ball through a stone hoop placed at either end of the court. You can use any part of the body except the hands, feet and head.

atoms.a: How did pitz gain the nickname “Game of Death”?
b: ++from the myth of the hero twins

atoms.a: Which three things have helped historians in deciphering the rules of pitz?
Which three parts of the body cannot be used to play pitz?

instruction.text: These Maya people have been chosen to play a game of pitz. Who do you think they are?

feedback.end: Games of pitz were not always light-hearted! Prisoners of war were sometimes forced to play against city-state rulers and were sacrificed if they lost.

instruction.text: You are interviewing a champion of pitz. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Congratulations on winning the game of ((++pitz blitz))! How did you manage it?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.8st'>Congratulations on winning the game of pitz! How did you manage it?</prosody>

atoms.b: We have a very strong team and focused on getting as many goals as possible through the ((++stone_ring plastic_goal)).
The ((++ball sword)) that you were using looks very strange. What is it made of?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.8st'>The ball that you were using looks very strange. What is it made of?</prosody>

atoms.b: It is made of ((++rubber sponge)). We wear ((++leather colourful)) padding to protect us because the ball is so hard!
Sounds like it can be a dangerous game! Which parts of your ((++body shield)) do you use to play?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.8st'>Sounds like it can be a dangerous game! Which parts of your body do you use to play?</prosody>

atoms.b: I use my ((++elbows,_knees_and_hips hands,_feet_and_head)) since the rules forbid most other things.
Impressive skills! Thank you for speaking with me!
